product_wide_rationale: It carries the goals Appendix A conflict rules and the authority to change Product law, which bind every child Domain and every law record, so no single child Domain can own it.
summary: One validated contract table holds every goals Appendix A rule with its enforcing mechanism or a listed gap, and applying a rule leaves a record. An agent changes law that is not serious under P12 with a recorded reason, and that revision makes the record derived; serious changes, every law change at crucial size, and governed scope cuts keep operator approval. The P12 Domain test counts the child home and applicability Domains of the laws a change adds, modifies, or removes, before and after the change; a Domain-registry change counts the child Domains of the entries and relation ends it changes; the Product-root Domain and the Domains of shipped code are not counted. Operator approval points fall in five classes or stay as listed gaps. Follow-up items carry a rule label in Linear.
title: The conflict rules are one checked table, and an agent changes law that is not serious
